mask.title: Mask
mask.description: Image mask for image inpainting mode. If provided, aspect_ratio, width, and height inputs are ignored.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed. Set for reproducible generation

image.title: Image
image.description: Input image for image to image or inpainting mode. If provided, aspect_ratio, width, and height inputs are ignored.

model.description: Which model to run inference with. The dev model performs best with around 28 inference steps but the schnell model only needs 4 steps.

width.title: Width
width.description: Width of generated image. Only works if `aspect_ratio` is set to custom. Will be rounded to nearest multiple of 16. Incompatible with fast generation

height.title: Height
height.description: Height of generated image. Only works if `aspect_ratio` is set to custom. Will be rounded to nearest multiple of 16. Incompatible with fast generation

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Prompt for generated image. If you include the `trigger_word` used in the training process you are more likely to activate the trained object, style, or concept in the resulting image.

go_fast.title: Go Fast
go_fast.description: Run faster predictions with model optimized for speed (currently fp8 quantized); disable to run in original bf16

extra_lora.title: Extra Lora
extra_lora.description: Load LoRA weights. Supports Replicate models in the format <owner>/<username> or <owner>/<username>/<version>, HuggingFace URLs in the format huggingface.co/<owner>/<model-name>, CivitAI URLs in the format civitai.com/models/<id>[/<model-name>], or arbitrary .safetensors URLs from the Internet. For example, 'fofr/flux-pixar-cars'

lora_scale.title: Lora Scale
lora_scale.description: Determines how strongly the main LoRA should be applied. Sane results between 0 and 1 for base inference. For go_fast we apply a 1.5x multiplier to this value; we've generally seen good performance when scaling the base value by that amount. You may still need to experiment to find the best value for your particular lora.

megapixels.description: Approximate number of megapixels for generated image

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio for the generated image. If custom is selected, uses height and width below & will run in bf16 mode

guidance_scale.title: Guidance Scale
guidance_scale.description: Guidance scale for the diffusion process. Lower values can give more realistic images. Good values to try are 2, 2.5, 3 and 3.5

output_quality.title: Output Quality
output_quality.description: Quality when saving the output images, from 0 to 100. 100 is best quality, 0 is lowest quality. Not relevant for .png outputs

prompt_strength.title: Prompt Strength
prompt_strength.description: Prompt strength when using img2img. 1.0 corresponds to full destruction of information in image

extra_lora_scale.title: Extra Lora Scale
extra_lora_scale.description: Determines how strongly the extra LoRA should be applied. Sane results between 0 and 1 for base inference. For go_fast we apply a 1.5x multiplier to this value; we've generally seen good performance when scaling the base value by that amount. You may still need to experiment to find the best value for your particular lora.

replicate_weights.title: Replicate Weights
replicate_weights.description: Load LoRA weights. Supports Replicate models in the format <owner>/<username> or <owner>/<username>/<version>, HuggingFace URLs in the format huggingface.co/<owner>/<model-name>, CivitAI URLs in the format civitai.com/models/<id>[/<model-name>], or arbitrary .safetensors URLs from the Internet. For example, 'fofr/flux-pixar-cars'

num_inference_steps.description: Number of denoising steps. More steps can give more detailed images, but take longer.

disable_safety_checker.title: Disable Safety Checker

mask.description: Input mask for inpaint mode. Black areas will be preserved, white areas will be inpainted.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed. Leave blank to randomize the seed

image.title: Image
image.description: Input image for img2img or inpaint mode

width.title: Width
width.description: Width of output image

height.title: Height
height.description: Height of output image

prompt.description: Input prompt

lora_scale.title: Lora Scale
lora_scale.description: LoRA additive scale. Only applicable on trained models.

refine_steps.title: Refine Steps
refine_steps.description: For base_image_refiner, the number of steps to refine, defaults to num_inference_steps

guidance_scale.title: Guidance Scale
guidance_scale.description: Scale for classifier-free guidance

apply_watermark.title: Apply Watermark
apply_watermark.description: Applies a watermark to enable determining if an image is generated in downstream applications. If you have other provisions for generating or deploying images safely, you can use this to disable watermarking.

high_noise_frac.title: High Noise Frac
high_noise_frac.description: For expert_ensemble_refiner, the fraction of noise to use

prompt_strength.title: Prompt Strength
prompt_strength.description: Prompt strength when using img2img / inpaint. 1.0 corresponds to full destruction of information in image

replicate_weights.title: Replicate Weights
replicate_weights.description: Replicate LoRA weights to use. Leave blank to use the default weights.

num_inference_steps.title: Num Inference Steps
num_inference_steps.description: Number of denoising steps

disable_safety_checker.title: Disable Safety Checker
disable_safety_checker.description: Disable safety checker for generated images. This feature is only available through the API. See [https://replicate.com/docs/how-does-replicate-work#safety](https://replicate.com/docs/how-does-replicate-work#safety)

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed for reproducible training. Leave empty to use a random seed

ti_lr.title: Ti Lr
ti_lr.description: Scaling of learning rate for training textual inversion embeddings. Don't alter unless you know what you're doing.

is_lora.title: Is Lora
is_lora.description: Whether to use LoRA training. If set to False, will use Full fine tuning

lora_lr.title: Lora Lr
lora_lr.description: Scaling of learning rate for training LoRA embeddings. Don't alter unless you know what you're doing.

lora_rank.title: Lora Rank
lora_rank.description: Rank of LoRA embeddings. Don't alter unless you know what you're doing.

resolution.title: Resolution
resolution.description: Square pixel resolution which your images will be resized to for training

input_images.title: Input Images
input_images.description: A .zip or .tar file containing the image files that will be used for fine-tuning

lr_scheduler.description: Learning rate scheduler to use for training

token_string.title: Token String
token_string.description: A unique string that will be trained to refer to the concept in the input images. Can be anything, but TOK works well

caption_prefix.title: Caption Prefix
caption_prefix.description: Text which will be used as prefix during automatic captioning. Must contain the `token_string`. For example, if caption text is 'a photo of TOK', automatic captioning will expand to 'a photo of TOK under a bridge', 'a photo of TOK holding a cup', etc.

lr_warmup_steps.title: Lr Warmup Steps
lr_warmup_steps.description: Number of warmup steps for lr schedulers with warmups.

max_train_steps.title: Max Train Steps
max_train_steps.description: Number of individual training steps. Takes precedence over num_train_epochs

num_train_epochs.title: Num Train Epochs
num_train_epochs.description: Number of epochs to loop through your training dataset

unet_learning_rate.title: Unet Learning Rate
unet_learning_rate.description: Learning rate for the U-Net. We recommend this value to be somewhere between `1e-6` to `1e-5`.

checkpointing_steps.title: Checkpointing Steps
checkpointing_steps.description: Number of steps between saving checkpoints. Set to very very high number to disable checkpointing, because you don't need one.

clipseg_temperature.title: Clipseg Temperature
clipseg_temperature.description: How blurry you want the CLIPSeg mask to be. We recommend this value be something between `0.5` to `1.0`. If you want to have more sharp mask (but thus more errorful), you can decrease this value.

mask_target_prompts.title: Mask Target Prompts
mask_target_prompts.description: Prompt that describes part of the image that you will find important. For example, if you are fine-tuning your pet, `photo of a dog` will be a good prompt. Prompt-based masking is used to focus the fine-tuning process on the important/salient parts of the image

input_images_filetype.description: Filetype of the input images. Can be either `zip` or `tar`. By default its `infer`, and it will be inferred from the ext of input file.

crop_based_on_salience.title: Crop Based On Salience
crop_based_on_salience.description: If you want to crop the image to `target_size` based on the important parts of the image, set this to True. If you want to crop the image based on face detection, set this to False

use_face_detection_instead.title: Use Face Detection Instead
use_face_detection_instead.description: If you want to use face detection instead of CLIPSeg for masking. For face applications, we recommend using this option.

You may still need to experiment to find the best value for your particular lora.
